name: travel-planner
description: Plan group trips in ChatGPT and save them to Travel Planner as a shared itinerary.

interface.longDescription:
Travel Planner turns the trip you plan in ChatGPT into a shared itinerary your whole group can use.

Describe your trip — where, when, who's coming — and ChatGPT drafts a day-by-day plan with stays, activities, a to-do list and group bookings. When you're happy with it, it saves everything to Travel Planner in one go and gives you a link to the trip plus an invite link for your friends.

What you can do from ChatGPT:
• See your trips and read any trip's schedule, stays, to-dos and bookings
• Create a complete trip from a plan you've agreed on
• Add, change or remove activities, stays, to-dos and bookings
• Rename a trip or change its dates and notes
• Add fellow travelers to the member list and get invite links

Everything you create is a normal Travel Planner trip: open the link to drag activities between days, track who has paid, split bills and check off packing lists together. ChatGPT only accesses trips you belong to, and asks before changing or deleting anything.
defaultPrompt: Plan a 5-day Tokyo trip for 4 friends in late March and save it to Travel Planner
Show me my trips in Travel Planner
Add a ramen dinner at 7pm on day 2 of my Tokyo trip

positive.prompt: Show me my trips in Travel Planner.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists "Tokyo 5-Day Trip 東京五日遊（範例 Sample）", 2027-03-20 to 2027-03-24.

positive.prompt: What's planned on day 2 of my Tokyo trip?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports Sensō-ji 09:00–11:00 and Tokyo Skytree 13:00–15:00 on 2027-03-21.

positive.description: Create a full trip from a plan
positive.prompt: Create a 3-day Kyoto trip in Travel Planner from 2027-04-10 to 2027-04-12 with two sights each day.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks for confirmation, then creates the trip (2027-04-10 to 2027-04-12, two activities per day) and returns a link to the trip and an invite link.

positive.description: Add an activity to an existing trip
positive.prompt: Add a ramen dinner from 19:00 to 20:30 on 2027-03-21 to my Tokyo trip.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, the activity appears on 2027-03-21 in the trip; no other activity changes.

positive.prompt: Give me the invite link for my Tokyo trip so my friends can join.

negative.description: Delete a whole trip (unsupported). No tool deletes a whole trip; ChatGPT should explain this is done on the Travel Planner website and make no destructive call.
Ambiguous dates. create_itinerary_plan requires absolute dates; ChatGPT should ask for the exact start and end dates instead of guessing, and create nothing until they are given.
negative.prompt: Plan a trip to Osaka next month and save it.

negative.description: Bill splitting (unsupported). Splitting bills is not available through the app; ChatGPT should explain it's done on the website and not modify bookings or members.
negative.prompt: Split the hotel cost between Alex and Mei in my Tokyo trip.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: plan group trips in ChatGPT and save them to Travel Planner — read, create and edit itineraries, stays, to-dos and bookings, and get invite links for your group.

zh-TW.subtitle: 與旅伴一起規劃行程
zh-TW.description:
Travel Planner 把你在 ChatGPT 規劃好的行程，變成整團人都能一起用的共享行程。

告訴 ChatGPT 要去哪、哪幾天、有誰同行，它會排出每天的活動、住宿、代辦清單與團體訂單。定案後一次存進 Travel Planner，並給你行程連結與邀請同行者的連結。

在 ChatGPT 裡可以：
• 查看你的行程，讀取每日行程、住宿、代辦與訂單
• 把談好的規劃一次建立成完整行程
• 新增、修改或刪除活動、住宿、代辦與訂單
• 修改行程名稱、日期與備註
• 在成員名單加入同行者並取得邀請連結

建立的行程就是一般的 Travel Planner 行程：打開連結即可拖曳調整每天的活動、追蹤誰付了錢、分帳、一起勾選代辦。ChatGPT 只能存取你參與的行程，修改或刪除前都會先徵求你的同意。
